name: Nathan
overview: Nathan was a male prophet during the reign of King David, known for his role as a fearless messenger of God. While his tribal affiliation and family details are not recorded, he is distinctly recognized as a prophet who played a significant role in David's reign. No additional personal notes are provided beyond his prophetic office.
namesAndTitles: The name Nathan means 'gift' in Hebrew, reflecting a proper name without indication of divine bestowal. This meaning aligns with his role as a divinely appointed prophet, though the name itself was not given by God according to the record.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Nathan beyond his designation as a prophet. No other relational details are provided in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Nathan is significant in the biblical narrative for his courageous confrontation of King David regarding his sin with Bathsheba, demonstrating the prophetic duty to uphold God's truth before rulers. He also conveyed God's covenant promise of an everlasting dynasty to David and was instrumental in securing Solomon's succession to the throne. Through his ministry, Nathan exemplifies God's justice and mercy, highlighting the possibility of forgiveness when repentance is genuine.
